text: Efua's knee op is sometime next week, she's been putting it off since the spring. Remind me to text her the day before.
bumped into Alfie at the shop, still obsessed w/ warhammer, painting a whole ork army apparently. bday end of month - paints or brushes wd go down well

Ines said her mum's hip replacement went fine, she's home now but can't do stairs for a few weeks so they've moved a bed into the living room. Her mum's bored out of her mind, misses her bridge club. Ines is staying with her the first fortnight then her brother Florin takes over. I should drop some puzzle books round for her mum sometime next week.
So Mandla's band have a gig at the Fleece early March and he's really nervous about it, first time playing his own stuff. Should go. And remind me to message him good luck that afternoon.
Francesca - Frankie - is learning to crochet, made a blanket for her niece's christening. Very proud of it.
Gemma and Louis cancelled the trip to Lisbon, his dad's not well. Need to check in with Gemma over the weekend.
dentist thurs 9am, then pick up my prescription afterwards
Shira's daughter starts secondary over the summer, Shira more anxious than the kid tbh
Call with Lucy. Her scan results come back sometime next week. She's trying not to think about it. Don't forget to ring her the day after.

Neha loves the Arsenal women's team, has a season ticket, goes with her brother Karan most Sundays. They've been going since it was basically empty, now it sells out. She's got a signed shirt from the Euros squad framed in the hallway. Wants to go to an away game in Europe at some point, maybe Barcelona if they draw them.
Karan's birthday's at the end of the month. He's been dropping hints about a new pair of running shoes, the Hokas he keeps going on about.
Joy had her gallbladder out on Monday. Discharged the next day. Says the worst bit was the hospital food lol
zeynep's sister getting married in early june, zeynep is maid of honour and stressing about the speech

Talked to Caitlin about the book club. She's reading the new Sally Rooney and hated it so far, says nothing happens. Next meet is sometime next week at hers, and she wants us to pick something lighter for December, maybe a crime novel. Her mum is coming to stay that weekend so she might move it to the Thursday. Need to finish the book before then.
Elena mentioned her dad had a fall, broke his wrist. He's in a cast for six weeks. I should send her something, maybe flowers for him.
Akira Tanaka from work, plays go competitively, ranked in some regional league. Tournament over the summer in Osaka.
need to book the car in for MOT sometime next week, and sort the bins
Ivan's surgery got called off, the surgeon was ill. Rescheduled for early December now. He's fed up waiting.
Florin brought his new puppy to the park, a beagle called Biscuit. Biscuit has her jabs at the vet next week.

Rachel asked if I can water her plants while she's in hospital. She goes in on the 14th for the hysterectomy and expects to be out a few days after, then signed off for six weeks. I'm doing Tuesday and Friday, her sister does the weekend. She's nervous about the anaesthetic more than anything. Remind me to text her the night before.
helen's 60th in november!! husband planning a surprise party, she's into gardening and jigsaws
Tamar told me Tunde's mum passed away last weekend. Funeral is end of the month. Must send Tunde a card and maybe drop food round before then.
Suzanne's into pottery now, wheel throwing classes on Wednesdays. Wants her own wheel eventually.
Ask Santiago how the physio went. Had his first session this morning after the ACL op.

jasmine doing the half marathon in the spring, first one ever, training w her partner Graham. she's terrified of the hills. long runs sat mornings, physio for her shin splints the day before each one. said shed love a decent running belt, keeps losing gels. graham doing it too but he's done loads
Aisha's son Hugo got into the county chess team!! starts training sessions in January.
Bogdan and his wife celebrating 25 years end of the month, renewing vows apparently. remind me to get a card the week before
Dong's into vinyl, collects old Motown pressings. Birthday's sometime in early March, keep an eye out at record fairs.

voice memo: ok so had coffee with Efua and Ines, Efua's op is now confirmed for Tuesday the 3rd, she'll be in overnight and her partner's picking her up the next morning. Ines is going to sit with her that afternoon. I said I'd do a meal drop the day after she gets home. Also Ines mentioned her own birthday is end of the month and she wants to do a games night, she's really into Wingspan and Catan at the moment.
Mandla said the gig went really well, packed room. Need to ask him if they recorded it.
Lucy all clear!! Results came back this afternoon. Huge relief.
didn't see anyone today. just reading. finished the dune books finally
Gemma Murphy - new neighbour at no 12. Has two cats, Pickle and Moss. Works nights at the Royal as a nurse.
Alfie's dad going in for a heart bypass sometime next week, Alfie's pretty shaken up. I should check in with him afterwards.
Joy's knitting a jumper for her grandson, first time doing colourwork. Wants to try socks next.
chat w Neha re her mum - knee replacement early feb, then 6wks recovery at Neha's place. Neha taking time off work for the first fortnight.
Caitlin's engagement party is end of the month. I'm doing the playlist. She loves Fleetwood Mac and anything 80s.
Note to self: Karan's results day is sometime next week. Text him that morning. He's convinced he failed the stats paper.
Zeynep's grandmother is in hospital with pneumonia. Zeynep is flying out to Izmir tomorrow and will be there for at least a week.
Helen said the party's off - her husband let it slip so they're doing a meal instead, just family, early November. still going to get her the gardening book she mentioned.
Akira's wife is expecting, due over the summer. They found out it's a girl. Don't forget to congratulate him properly next time I see him.
Elena plays in a five a side league Thursdays, mainly goalkeeper. Supports Celtic, big rivalry with her brother Louis who's a Rangers fan.
remember: get milk, return the library books before the weekend, renew passport sometime this month
Florin says his mother-in-law moves in with them in the new year, after her stroke. He sounds exhausted already. Should take him for a pint sometime next week.
Louis Brennan, met at Tamar's thing. Into climbing, mainly bouldering, goes to the wall in town a few times a week. Recovering from a finger pulley injury though.
Tunde rang. Doing okay. Going back to work a week after the funeral, thinks routine will help.
Santiago and Jasmine got the keys to their new flat yesterday!!! Housewarming sometime over the summer once they've painted.
Graham's cataract op is on the 9th. His daughter Shira is driving him and staying the night after. Remind me to ring Graham the day after to see how it went, and ask Shira if she needs anything.

Long call with Ivan. He's still waiting on the new surgery date, been off work since August and money's tight. Wife Helen is working extra shifts. He's been getting back into chess online to keep his head busy, he's actually pretty good. Says the worst part is not knowing. Need to call him again end of the week and maybe ask if he wants to come round for dinner sometime next week.
Bianchi family bbq got rained off. Francesca says they'll try again end of the month.
